svg.text: Gemma 1B guesses, and nothing gets through

g.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
g.text: $ python ask.py ask --box ofrenda --url http://127.0.0.1:8089/v1 --model gemma-3-1b-it --system voices/femia.md
"what was the secret in the biscochitos"
(Femia’s voice, soft and laced with a gentle sadness)
Ah, my little one… it was a secret, you see. A small thing, like a hummingbird’s wing. It wasn't much, but it
mattered to Rosa. It was… a touch of sweetness, a whisper of something special. Don’t worry about it now. Just
remember the warmth of her smile.
